notes:
A calmer Dear Diary lock screen: book logo, soft pastel background, fingerprint hint and tidy unlock/diary-PIN choices. Light and dark lock colors follow your last selected app background. Retry stays available when you cancel the Android prompt.

Android still handles fingerprint or phone-PIN verification securely. Diary PIN fallback, screenshot protection and verified device proof are unchanged.

Chat topic star now adds an unused question directly to your draft in one tap, with no options list. Tap Send when ready. The brief feedback fades after 3 seconds.
